metadata.name: Iron Coast
metadata.description: A large beach assault for 24 to 32 a side, built from the owner's reference: landing craft in the surf, a beach of hedgehogs and craters, an irregular cliff with seven ways up (the far-west steps, the west stair, the stone stair under B2, the grand stair through its gatehouse, the stair under B3, the cave and its tunnel, the east walkway to the headland), four gun casemates on the crest, trenches and terraces behind, and the village with its round fort. Breakthrough: take the beach, destroy two of the four guns, hold the fort's command room. Team Deathmatch over the whole map.
